question: Where is the head protrusion situated on the rising liṅga?
premises: The topic is the head protrusion on the liṅga.
Its position is specified relative to the liṅga’s rise.
It is located at the rise and above.
inference: The head protrusion is situated at the rise of the liṅga and upward from there.
plain_english: Therefore, O twice-born one, the head protrusion is at the rise of the liṅga and above it.
